name: Eldercare Locator
description: Free help finding care for an older parent or relative, and support for the person caring for them.
hours: Mon to Fri, 8 a.m. to 9 p.m. Eastern
eligibility: Anyone caring for an older adult, or an older adult looking for help.

steps: Call 1-800-677-1116, or search by ZIP code at eldercare.acl.gov.
Ask who helps caregivers in your county.
